fulfillment_view_attention_description: Held, delayed, and failed fulfillments, longest wait first.
fulfillment_view_held_description: Open work stopped by a hold at the source.
fulfillment_view_delayed_description: Open work past its fulfill-by date or without progress, and shipments with a delivery problem or past their estimate.
fulfillment_view_open_description: Fulfillment work the source still expects to complete.
fulfillment_view_in_transit_description: Shipments that left a location and aren’t delivered yet.
fulfillment_view_all_description: Every fulfillment order and shipment your connected systems report.
fulfillment_duration_days: {count, plural, one {{count, number} day} other {{count, number} days}}
fulfillment_duration_hours: {count, plural, one {{count, number} hour} other {{count, number} hours}}
fulfillment_duration_minutes: {count, plural, one {{count, number} minute} other {{count, number} minutes}}
fulfillment_units: {count, plural, one {{count, number} unit} other {{count, number} units}}
fulfillment_reason_removed: The source no longer reports this fulfillment.
fulfillment_advice_awaiting_payment: Confirm the payment was captured before you release the hold.
fulfillment_advice_high_risk_of_fraud: Review the order’s fraud analysis before you release the hold. Cancel the order instead if it isn’t genuine.
fulfillment_advice_incorrect_address: Confirm the shipping address with the customer and correct it at the source.
fulfillment_advice_inventory_out_of_stoc: Restock the items, or move the work to a location that has them.
fulfillment_advice_unknown_delivery_date: Agree on a delivery date with the customer before you release the hold.
fulfillment_advice_awaiting_return_items: Wait for the returned items to arrive, or release the hold if they aren’t needed.
fulfillment_advice_other: Check why the work was held at the source.
fulfillment_next_release_title: Resolve the hold reason, then release the hold
fulfillment_next_release_body: {advice} Releasing the hold asks {source} to resume the work. Luma counts the fulfillment as resumed only when a fresh read shows fewer units remaining.
fulfillment_next_hold_body: {advice} Luma can’t release holds for this connection. The change shows here after the next read.
fulfillment_next_failed_body: Find out why the fulfillment failed, then retry it or create a new one at the source. Luma shows the new state after the next read.
fulfillment_next_carrier_unknown_title: Check the shipment with the carrier
fulfillment_next_carrier_body: Use tracking number {tracking}. Arrange redelivery or collection with the customer if needed. The delivery shows here once the source reports it.
fulfillment_next_carrier_no_tracking_bod: No tracking number is reported, so ask the fulfilling location which carrier took it. Arrange redelivery or collection with the customer if needed. The delivery shows here once the source reports it.
fulfillment_next_location_title: Ask {location} what’s holding up the work
fulfillment_next_location_unknown_title: Ask the fulfilling location what’s holding up the work
fulfillment_next_location_body: Check whether the items were picked and packed. If the order has the wrong shipping method, correcting it changes how the order ships but doesn’t prove that it shipped. Luma looks for a shipment or completed work in later reads.
fulfillment_next_open_body: Luma flags this work if it passes its fulfill-by date or shows no progress for {hours, plural, one {{hours, number} hour} other {{hours, number} hours}}.
fulfillment_next_shipped_body: The shipment is on its way. Luma flags it if the carrier reports a delivery problem or the delivery estimate passes.
fulfillment_next_finished_body: The source reports this fulfillment as finished or no longer expected.
fulfillment_diagnosis_was_due: It was due to be fulfilled {time}.
fulfillment_diagnosis_removed_body: The source removed this fulfillment. Luma keeps its history as evidence.
fulfillment_diagnosis_held_body: The source stopped this work until the hold is released.
fulfillment_diagnosis_delivery_body: The carrier reports a problem delivering this shipment.
fulfillment_diagnosis_late_body: The shipment was expected {time}, and the source hasn’t reported it delivered.
fulfillment_diagnosis_stalled_body: The work is open, but the source hasn’t reported anything new.
fulfillment_empty_problems_body: Held, delayed, and failed fulfillments appear here as soon as a connected system reports them.
fulfillment_empty_filtered_body: Try another order number, tracking number, location, or source.
fulfillment_empty_all_body: Fulfillment orders and shipments appear once a connected store or ERP reports them. Check Data sync for import progress.
fulfillment_list_search_placeholder: Order, tracking number, location, or source ID…
fulfillment_list_note: Work without progress for {hours, plural, one {{hours, number} hour} other {{hours, number} hours}} counts as delayed. Each connection’s work is listed separately.
fulfillment_fact_location_unlinked: Not linked to a Luma location
fulfillment_evidence_note: Luma counts progress only from what a source reports in a fresh read. A request the source accepted, or a corrected shipping method, isn’t progress until a later read shows the work completed or shipped.
fulfillment_evidence_no_progress_times: The source doesn’t report progress times
fulfillment_workflow_method_note: Changes the shipping method. It doesn’t ship the order.
fulfillment_timeline_note: States Luma read from {source}, newest first, with what changed since the read before.
fulfillment_timeline_repeated: {count, plural, one {Read {count, number} time, no change} other {Read {count, number} times, no change}}
fulfillment_detail_offline: You’re offline. Reconnect to refresh this fulfillment.
fulfillment_detail_missing_body: This fulfillment isn’t in this workspace, or no connected system reports it anymore.
fulfillment_detail_no_access: You no longer have access to fulfillment in this workspace.
fulfillment_detail_refresh_failed: This fulfillment couldn’t be refreshed. The details below may be out of date.
fulfillment_detail_load_failed: This fulfillment couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
fulfillment_items_unlinked: Item not linked to a SKU
fulfillment_activity_empty: Luma hasn’t acted on this order or its issues yet.
fulfillment_order_not_read: Order not read from this source
fulfillment_order_note: Customer, payment, and address details are on the order, read live from {source}.
fulfillment_others_empty: No other fulfillment work or shipments are reported for this order.
fulfillment_issues_empty: No issues recorded for this fulfillment or its order.
fulfillment_handoff_unknown_note: A label or booking does not confirm that the warehouse or carrier has received the shipment.
fulfillment_tracking_stale: No carrier update for at least 48 hours. Refresh the source or investigate with the carrier.
fulfillment_read_stale: This source was last read more than 15 minutes ago. Refresh before relying on its status.
fulfillment_next_handoff_body: Check with the merchant or warehouse whether the carrier has collected this shipment. Refresh tracking for independent confirmation.
fulfillment_field_deadline_description: Work with a deadline first, then the rest by last progress.
fulfillment_field_signals_description: Why work needs attention: on hold, overdue, stalled, a delivery problem, late delivery or failed.
fulfillment_field_holds_description: Hold reasons the source reports. Holds a source doesn’t report are unknown.
fulfillment_field_stage_description: Who has the shipment, as the source reports: merchant, warehouse, carrier or delivered. A label alone doesn’t confirm a handoff.
fulfillment_field_progress_description: The source’s last progress, else its last update or Luma’s last read.
fulfillment_list_pagination_total: {count, plural, one {{count, number} fulfillment} other {{count, number} fulfillments}}
fulfillment_preview_unavailable: The fulfillment’s details couldn’t be loaded.
